audience.text: Java developers building applications that require reading, writing, and manipulating Excel .xlsx workbooks without runtime dependencies on Apache POI or commercial libraries.

capabilities.text: The library supports creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks through Workbook and Worksheet APIs.
capabilities.title: Read and write Excel workbooks

capabilities.text: Cell values, fonts, number formats, borders, alignment, and fill can be set via Style objects assigned to individual cells.
capabilities.title: Cell styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Data validation and conditional formatting rules can be applied to worksheet ranges using Validation and ConditionalFormatting APIs.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: 18 of 25 chart types can be created programmatically; drawing shapes and Excel tables (ListObjects) are also supported.
capabilities.title: Chart and shape support

capabilities.text: Page setup, row/column sizing, freezing panes, and print options are configurable via PageSetup and Worksheet APIs.
capabilities.title: Page setup and print layout

capabilities.text: Cell comments, embedded images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP), and hyperlinks can be added and managed programmatically.
capabilities.title: Comments, pictures, and hyperlinks

limitations.text: Saving is currently limited to .xlsx format only.
ChartEx types (Waterfall, Treemap, Sunburst, Histogram, Box and Whisker, Funnel, Map) cannot be created programmatically.
Formulas are stored and round-tripped but the library is not a full spreadsheet calculation engine.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation and editing in Java without requiring Microsoft Excel or a commercial license.
Provides a pure-Java implementation for XLSX processing with no runtime Apache POI dependency, using POI only in test scope for compatibility checks.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java spreadsheet library for creating, loading, modifying, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks, targeting Java 17.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Developers build the project with 'mvn package' and run tests with 'mvn test' using JUnit Jupiter.

workflows.name: Release publishing
workflows.text: Releases publish to Maven Central via the maven-central-release.yml workflow.

workflows.name: Quick start
workflows.text: Developers create workbooks, write cell values, apply styling, and save to .xlsx using Workbook, Worksheet, and Cell APIs.
